detail.title: Wired Keyboard and Mouse Combo
detail.overview: Discover the Wired Keyboard and Mouse Combo by Bestor, engineered for high performance, durability, and seamless connectivity.
features: Effortlessly connect your keyboard and mouse with a simple plug-and-play setup.
Enjoy quiet typing with 12 Fn shortcuts and a chiclet-style keyboard.
Experience speed and precision with 1600 dpi, tracking on any surface.
Sleek black design, modern look, and durable for everyday reliability.
